rows.title: How do I find the right licensed contractor?
rows.evidence_excerpt: Get at least three written bids on your project, and make sure you’re comparing bids based on identical plans, specifications, and scope of work. Do not automatically accept the lowest bid. Ask to see a copy of the Certificate of Insurance. Commercial general liability insurance is not required; however, it covers damage to your property.

rows.title: Contract and binding agreements
rows.evidence_excerpt: A thorough contract tells how the work will be done, when it will be done, what materials will be used and how much it will cost. Make sure the contract includes everything that is agreed to, up to and including complete cleanup and removal of debris and materials. Always update your contract ... note it in writing on a change order.

rows.title: California Civil Code §1954
rows.evidence_excerpt: A landlord may enter ... To make necessary or agreed repairs. The notice shall include the date, approximate time, and purpose of the entry. Twenty-four hours shall be presumed to be reasonable notice in absence of evidence to the contrary. Entry may not be made during other than normal business hours unless the tenant consents. The tenant and the landlord may agree orally to an entry to make agreed repairs ... agreement shall include the date and approximate time ... within one week.
